name: Creative Tools
tagline: Browser tools for shapes, type and motion. Self-hosted, with everything running in your browser.

tools.name: GLYF
tools.description: Draw geometric glyphs on a snap grid, then use them as the characters of a dithered image, video or webcam feed. Exports PNG, SVG and MP4.

tools.name: DURANDAL
tools.description: Turn images, video or a webcam feed into pixel art: error-diffusion and pattern dithering in two tones, a palette or CMYK, with cell shapes and keyframes. Exports PNG, SVG and MP4.

tools.name: LEELA
tools.description: Animated grainy gradients and mesh gradients, blended in Oklab, with seamless loops.

tools.name: BLOOM
tools.description: Grow procedural flowers that bloom on a gradient: carnations, lilies, tulips, daisies and more, in flat color ramps, with wind, camera drift and depth of field. Exports PNG and MP4.

tools.name: TYCHO
tools.description: A beat-synced grid of looping geometric pattern tiles: checkers, stripes, rays, rings and dots in flat color, re-cut on the beat. Exports PNG, SVG and MP4.

tools.name: THOTH
tools.description: A live halftone sandbox: animated type, shapes, gradient fields, images, video or a webcam, screened as RGB, CMYK or one-ink dots on the GPU. Exports PNG and MP4.
